name: Calleo Indigenous Scholarship
summary: Up to $7,000 a year (or $10,000 at the excellence rate) for full-time Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander undergraduates.
key: Maximum value is $7,000 (base rate) or $10,000 (academic excellence rate).
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, with a Confirmation of Heritage.
Full-time in any Griffith undergraduate degree.
Minimum GPA of 4 for continuing students.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Opening soon for 2027; no closing date published yet.
May continue up to $21,000 (base) or $30,000 (excellence) overall, subject to donor approval.
